author: Forbes
description:
Paramount completed its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery on Tuesday, creating a new media mega-player called Skydance that will control large swaths of the entertainment industry and ending a monthslong saga as the merger has drawn widespread opposition in Hollywood.

Paramount announced Tuesday morning the deal had been finalized, after saying last week it expected to close the deal this day, with CEO David Ellison describing it as a “historic day” in a statement.
Skydance shares will start trading on the stock exchange under the ticker symbol “SKYD,” the company said Tuesday, while Warner Bros. shares will cease trading.

author: Forbes
description:
How do you go from a broke 22-year-old Wall Street trader whom no financial advisor would touch to building a multi-million dollar media empire, selling a scripted television show to Amazon MGM Studios, and bootstrapping a seven-figure financial technology startup?

In this episode of The Forbes Top Creator Show, host Steven Bertoni sits down with financial educator, 2x New York Times best-selling author (Rich AF, Well Endowed), and entrepreneur Vivian Tu (Your Rich BFF).

Vivian breaks down her evolution from a one-woman financial content engine into a FinTech founder with the launch of her app, Ask Dolly. She shares why she turned down venture capital to self-fund over $1,000,000 of her own capital, how she's turning her book Rich AF into a scripted television show currently in development with MGM Studios and Amazon, and her prescription for Gen Z's growing "financial nihilism."
